criteria.requirement: At constant Y, left-to-right X is forward and independent of X drawing rate.
criteria.check: independent signed read-increment test for two X slopes

criteria.requirement: At constant Y, right-to-left X is reverse and independent of X drawing rate.
criteria.check: independent signed read-increment test for two X slopes

criteria.requirement: Y alone produces 0.5, 1, 2 at bottom, centre, top and the exact quadratic intermediate values.
Y changes speed continuously during both forward and reverse reading with natural pitch, without an independent pitch shifter.
Ordinary horizontal or diagonal motion never resets the source cursor every hop; read positions advance continuously.
criteria.check: old RED trace then new GREEN full-BAR trace and WAV

criteria.requirement: Actual X reversal starts a 3-ms bounded transition to reverse or forward on the event sample.
Only a discontinuous X jump repositions the cursor with a safe transition; ordinary continuous travel does not.
Vertical motion loops an X-selected short slice, retains previous direction, and defaults forward on a first vertical stroke.
criteria.check: forward/reverse/default hold read-position and seam tests

criteria.requirement: XY history is preallocated for up to ten seconds; expired, future or uninitialised samples are never read.
criteria.check: boundary, wrap, startup, maximum sample-rate and allocation tests

criteria.requirement: History exhaustion or missing audio fades XY to aligned dry, and valid history reacquires without a position jump.
criteria.check: silent/expiry/re-entry WAV and mask continuity tests

criteria.requirement: Stereo channels share the exact same source position and remain finite and peak bounded.
criteria.check: stereo phase/reference, finite and peak tests

criteria.requirement: Existing trajectories round-trip unchanged; UI and state format and parameter IDs are unchanged.
BRAVO 1/2, COUNT 5, XY priority, manual BAR, DEPTH 0, bypass and 1024-sample delay retain previous behaviour.
Audio callback introduces no allocation, lock, UI, ValueTree, I/O or logging.
criteria.check: instrumented no-allocation test and source review

criteria.requirement: All 18 benchmark conditions at 44.1/48/96k and fixed/variable blocks have p99 <= 50% and max <= 80% of deadline.
Same-SHA Windows CI, comparison WAVs, per-AC Jev PASS and Codex final review precede SHA-verified new D manual-test placement.
criteria.check: CI run, artifact hash, WAV manifest and per-criterion review
